entities.summary: Linda Zarda Cook is an American businesswoman, who is CEO of Harbour Energy since 2014. She was previously CEO of Shell Gas & Power, part of Royal Dutch Shell, in the Netherlands until 2009. Cook was named the 44th most powerful woman in the world by Forbes magazine in September 2007.
